description:
Find buildings, developers, districts and cities of Cyprus on ailiste by name, in any language
(English, Greek, Russian, Ukrainian, Hebrew, Chinese); a typo is forgiven. At most 8 matches, best
first, each with its ailiste page. `lang` is the language of the names and links given back.

lang.description: The language of the names and links in the answer: en (English), el (Greek), ru (Russian), uk (Ukrainian), he (Hebrew) or zh (Chinese).
lang.title: Lang

query.description: What to look for, by its name: a building, a developer, a district or a city, in any language. A typo is forgiven.
query.title: Query
